Verify that the URL updates to include the cart state in the search parameters, and the UI displays the item in the cart. Note the current URL.     ## Result Format
    ``````markdown
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
        "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
    }
    ``````
